description:
Activate Drownyard Temple's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Drownyard Temple, causing you to gain two life.
Activate Drownyard Temple's second ability by paying {3}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Drownyard Temple enters the battlefield, triggering Amulet of Vigor, untapping Drownyard Temple.
Repeat.
